California.focus: Regional hub-and-spoke care collaboratives, workforce and technology
California.description: California plans a network of regional care collaboratives that bring primary, maternity, chronic disease and specialty care closer to home in rural and frontier communities.
initiatives: Rural Health Transformative Care Model
Regional hub-and-spoke networks anchored by hospitals, with shared transfer protocols, Project ECHO, OB Nest prenatal monitoring, e-Consult and perinatal psychiatry access.
Rural Health Workforce Development
A statewide workforce mapping tool, education pathways from high school to universities, train-the-trainer programs and retention incentives.
Rural Health Technology and Tools
EHR enhancements, health information exchange, cybersecurity and a technical assistance center.

Colorado.focus: Chronic disease prevention, telehealth, workforce and access
Colorado.description: Colorado plans to strengthen public-private partnerships, expand access, modernize delivery and focus on chronic disease prevention, with administrative costs held at 2.98%.
initiatives: Community health and prevention
Resources for rural hospitals and clinics to reduce chronic disease.
Telehealth and connected care
Telehealth, mobile health tools and monitoring, equipment and shared data systems.
Workforce
Recruiting and retaining local providers through streamlined credentialing, cross-training and education partnerships.
Access and innovative care models
Primary care, wellness, emergency, behavioral health and maternity services in rural communities.

Connecticut.focus: Population health, workforce, data and technology, care transformation
Connecticut.description: Connecticut's plan, led by the Department of Social Services, funds 31 targeted projects across four initiatives.
initiatives: Population Health Outcomes
Prevention, chronic disease management, maternal and behavioral health integration and root causes of disease.
Workforce
Recruitment, training and retention through education partnerships, telehealth support and career pipelines.
Data & Technology
Interoperability, health information exchange participation, telehealth infrastructure and analytics.
Care Transformation & Stability
Care coordination, value-based models and integration of medical, behavioral, dental and long-term services.

Delaware.focus: Access, workforce, innovation and outcomes for Sussex and Kent
Delaware.description: Delaware's plan addresses access and outcome disparities for about 400,000 residents of rural Sussex and Kent Counties through 15 integrated initiatives.
initiatives: Expand Access
Hope Centers for homeless populations, mobile health units, school-based health centers and library-based health services.
Strengthen Workforce
Delaware's first medical school with a primary care–rural health track, 'Train Here, Stay Here' awards and expanded training for NPs, PAs and CHWs.
Drive Innovation
Health IT for real-time insurance verification and prior authorization, a telehealth and remote-monitoring Catalyst Fund, and a diabetes wellness pilot.
Improve Outcomes
Food is Medicine infrastructure and value-based care readiness programs for rural providers and FQHCs.

Florida.focus: Access, outcomes, technology, workforce and financial sustainability across 31 counties
Florida.description: Florida's plan aims to modernize, stabilize and sustain rural health systems across 31 counties serving about 1.2 million Floridians.
initiatives: Improve Access
Rural and satellite clinics, mobile health, community paramedicine, tele-specialties, remote monitoring and retail pharmacy clinics.
Behavioral Health
Regional telepsychiatry hubs and workforce development.
Strengthen Workforce
The Clinical Training Investment Opportunity, with supervised rotations and five-year rural service commitments.
Ensure Financial Sustainability
Value-based payment models and integrated Medicare-Medicaid plans to stabilize rural hospitals.
